telling-time-skill-01.target: I can tell and write time to the hour on analog and digital clocks.
telling-time-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell and write time to the hour on analog and digital clocks.
telling-time-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Mixing up the hour hand and the minute hand. Try this: The short hand tells the hour; the long hand points to 12 at o'clock.

telling-time-skill-02.target: I can tell and write time to the half hour on analog and digital clocks.
telling-time-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell and write time to the half hour on analog and digital clocks.
telling-time-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Reading the next hour at half past (the hour hand is past 3, so it says 4:30). Try this: At half past, the hour hand is halfway between two numbers; read the number it has passed.

telling-time-skill-03.target: I can match analog and digital times and tell what time it will be one hour or half an hour later.
telling-time-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can match analog and digital times and tell what time it will be one hour or half an hour later.
telling-time-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing half past 6 as 6:50 or 6:3. Try this: Half past means 30 minutes; the long hand points to 6.
